source: DR 08 T6-6 — other sources, and the dividend change between the years
_source: "Savings interest 14,000 ; time-deposit interest 90,000 ; dividend 2,00,000 ; interest expense on a loan used to buy the shares 60,000. Individual under 60, old regime." "other-sources income = 14,000 + 90,000 + 2,00,000 = 3,04,000" (TY 2026-27); "0.20 × 2,00,000 = 40,000", "3,04,000 − 40,000 = 2,64,000" (TY 2025-26); "DED-80TTA-001: savings-account interest only, cap 10,000; min(14,000 , 10,000) = 10,000". TY 2025-26 is SOURCE_CHECKED (OS-DIVIDEND-INTEREST, 1961 s.57 proviso, D-194), not provisional (DR 08's W-080 erratum, D-211). No age is stated beyond under 60: the harness's person.
